dedupe_keys.name: wind erosion susceptibility mapping for north west victoria

description: Wind erosion susceptibility mapping for north west Victoria is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. A polygonal map of wind erosion susceptibility in the Victorian Mallee. The dataset was created by assigning relative susceptibility classes to landform component data mapped during the disaggregation of land systems project (refer to separate metadata entry). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Farming, Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-08-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
